mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pmis_operation_log ( module, action, biz_type, biz_id, user_id, username, request_url, http_method, method_signature, client_ip, user_agent, params_json, response_json, before_data, after_data, status, error_message, cost_ms, trace_id, tenant_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{module}, #{action}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{userId}, #{username}, #{requestUrl}, #{httpMethod}, #{methodSignature}, #{clientIp}, #{userAgent}, #{paramsJson}, #{responseJson}, #{beforeData}::jsonb, #{afterData}::jsonb, #{status}, #{errorMessage}, #{costMs}, #{traceId}, #{tenantId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, module, action, biz_type, biz_id, user_id, username, request_url, http_method, method_signature, client_ip, user_agent, params_json, response_json, before_data, after_data, status, error_message, cost_ms, trace_id, tenant_id, created_at FROM pmis_operation_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, module, action, biz_type, biz_id, user_id, username, request_url, http_method, method_signature, client_ip, user_agent, params_json, response_json, before_data, after_data, status, error_message, cost_ms, trace_id, tenant_id, created_at FROM pmis_operation_log WHERE biz_type = #{bizType} AND biz_id = #{bizId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM pmis_operation_log WHERE created_at < (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (#{days} || ' day')::interval)
